summary: Shift authentication approach: replace Internet Identity login with a simple email + password login that supports account creation and managing multiple Admin/User accounts tied to employee codes, while keeping the rest of the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System scope intact.
architectural_notes: Build as a simple web-based application layout ready for further backend integration.
Support Excel (.xlsx) import/export for raw data and reports.
Implement role-based access control (Admin/Salesman/Supplier), including admin-only edit permissions.
Maintain audit metadata on payment entries (timestamp and user who entered/edited).
Add robust file-type validation and parsing for uploads (XLSX vs CSV) and normalize imported fields to avoid runtime type errors in invoice/status logic.
Add admin-only data lifecycle controls (clear/reset/archive) for uploaded invoices and payment entries to support daily refresh workflows.
Add invoice ageing calculation (Ageing Days = today - invoiceDate) in invoice list views to support prioritizing/clearing oldest invoices first.
Ensure the Salesman-facing invoice list/template includes an "Ageing Days" (overdue) column so salesmen can quickly identify older invoices first (ideally sortable oldest-first).
Revisit login UX strictness: reduce friction/overly strict checks so users can access the app reliably while keeping role-based access control intact.

Authentication direction change: implement email+password credentials with a simple account creation flow and user identity keyed by employee code (support multiple Admin/User accounts); deprecate Internet Identity dependency.
known_issues: Previous build attempt failed (AI unable to implement request); user requested retry.

User reports role mismatch: after selecting/saving Admin in UI, app still shows role as User and Upload Excel option remains hidden (possible role assignment/UX issue with Internet Identity-based roles).
Uploading invoice data as CSV causes runtime error when clicking 'Show Invoice': "cannot use 'in' operator to search for paid in unpaid" (likely status field type/shape mismatch after CSV import).
User reports the login page is too strict and not usable; requests a less restrictive login flow.
Login flow does not persist correctly: on re-login the app prompts to create a new account each time instead of recognizing the existing account/session.
Role selection not sticking: user reports login always ends up as "User" account even when trying to use/admin role (admin-only UI remains hidden).
Internet Identity login is not usable for the user (unable to enter/use II), contributing to repeated login/account issues.
User asks how to change an account role from User to Admin, indicating role update/promotion flow is missing or unclear.

existing_features.title: Implement authentication using Internet Identity and role-based access control with roles: Admin, Salesman, Supplier. Provide a secure login screen that signs in with Internet Identity and then redirects to the correct dashboard/landing page based on the user’s assigned role.

Create an Admin Dashboard UI that shows summary cards for: Total Outstanding, Total Collection, Excess Collection, and Pending Balance. Display the company name “ADPL” prominently in the header and include the footer text “© 2026 ADPL Distribution Management System”.

Build a Raw Data Upload module for Admin to upload Excel (.xlsx) containing columns: Retailer Code, Retailer Name, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Salesman Name, Balance Amount. Parse the file client-side, validate required columns, and send the parsed rows to the backend to be stored. After upload, auto-display the dataset in a paginated table.
Add table tools on the Raw Data list: search by retailer name, search by retailer code, search by invoice number, and filter by salesman name.

Implement the Payment Entry workflow: clicking a retailer/invoice row opens a Payment Entry Form showing read-only invoice fields (Retailer Code/Name, Invoice Number/Date, Salesman Name, Balance Amount) and an editable Payment Entry section with required Type (SRR1 Supplier / SRR2 Salesman / TFC) and multi-mode payments.

Support split/part payments via an “Add Another Payment Mode” action that allows entering multiple payment lines (e.g., part cash, part cheque, part UPI). Auto-calculate the total entered amount and compare it to the invoice Balance Amount in real time.

Implement validation rules on the Payment Entry Form: amounts cannot be negative; cheque number is mandatory when Cheque is selected; transaction ID is mandatory when NEFT/RTGS/UPI is selected; cannot submit an empty payment form; require at least one payment line with a positive amount.

Implement excess payment handling: determine status based on total entered vs Balance Amount (Fully Paid, Partially Paid, Excess Payment). If excess occurs, show the warning text exactly: “Entered amount exceeds balance. Excess will be recorded.” Store the excess amount separately from normal collection in backend records.
On submit of a payment entry, save the entry, update remaining balance automatically, and display the confirmation message exactly: “Payment successfully recorded for ADPL”.

Add Payment History per retailer/invoice: provide a view that lists all recorded payments with timestamp, entered-by, type, mode line items, totals, and status. Expose this from the backend and render it in the frontend.

Implement Admin-only edit of an existing payment entry: Admin can open a recorded payment entry, modify it (including split lines), and save changes; the system must recompute related totals (remaining balance, total collected, excess) consistently.

Create a Reports section with filters (date range, salesman, type, mode of payment) and outputs: Total Collected, Total Excess, Pending Balance, and a Retailer-wise Ledger. Provide an Excel export download of report results.
Apply a corporate, clean, professional Blue & White visual design system across the app with mobile-responsive layouts and consistent UI for forms, tables, and dashboard cards.
Promote the current draft build of the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System to the Live (public) version now, without making additional functional changes.

Fix the runtime error when viewing invoices after uploading a CSV file: "cannot use 'in' operator to search for paid in unpaid". Update invoice status rendering logic so it safely handles the shape of `invoice.status` regardless of whether it is represented as a string (e.g., "unpaid") or as a variant-like object (e.g., `{ unpaid: null }`).
Add an Admin-only UI control in the Invoice Management (Raw Data Upload) page to erase/reset all existing data (invoices + payments) with a confirmation step to prevent accidental deletion.
Expose the new backend reset method to the frontend via a dedicated React Query mutation hook and ensure all relevant cached queries are invalidated/cleared after a successful reset.

Update the Admin "Invoice Management" page to present the existing destructive data reset action as a clear "Clear Old Data" button (admin-only) while keeping the current confirmation dialog safety step.

Add an "Ageing Days" feature to the invoices list so users can easily identify and prioritize older invoices: compute ageing as the number of days from each invoice's Invoice Date to today, display it in the invoices table, and provide a UI control to sort invoices by ageing (oldest first / newest first).

Add a downloadable invoice upload template on the Admin "Invoice Management" (Raw Data Upload) page that includes an "Ageing Days" column in the header so users can include it in their working sheet, while keeping the upload parser compatible (Ageing Days must remain optional and ignored during import).

Update the downloadable invoice upload template so the optional column header "Ageing Days" appears immediately after "Invoice Date" (i.e., placed next to Invoice Date) while keeping the column optional and ignored during import parsing.

Update the post-login onboarding so that a missing user profile does not block access to the app. Specifically, when the authenticated user has no saved profile, do not force a modal that prevents interacting with the app; instead allow the user to continue and optionally complete profile setup.

Adjust authenticated routing and layout rendering to handle users with missing/unknown role gracefully (treat as a non-admin default) so the UI remains usable while profile/role data loads or is absent.

Replace the current Internet Identity login screen with a simple Email + Password login UI and add a "Create Account" option that allows creating accounts with email, password, employee code, and role selection (Admin/User). All user-facing text must be in English.

Introduce a new frontend authentication state (separate from the existing Internet Identity hook) that persists the session credential returned from backend login (e.g., localStorage), provides login/logout helpers, and is used by routing/layout to determine whether the user is authenticated.

Update frontend data-fetching hooks and pages to call the backend using the new session credential and to derive the current role (admin/user) from the backend, ensuring existing admin-only UI sections (e.g., Dashboard, Invoice Upload/Clear Old Data, Edit Payment) remain correctly gated.

Replace the current Internet Identity-only Login page with a simple Email + Password login UI that reliably allows existing users to sign in without being forced into creating a new account each time.

Add a dedicated frontend authentication state (separate from the Internet Identity hook) that persists the backend session credential (e.g., localStorage) and is used to determine whether the user is authenticated on page refresh/revisit.
Fix role handling so that after login the correct role (Admin/User) is used across routing and UI gating, and the user is no longer always treated as "User".

Update post-login landing/redirect behavior so the app reliably navigates to the correct landing page based on the authenticated user’s role using the new session-based authentication (admin -> admin dashboard; non-admin -> invoices page).

Ensure the app provides a usable fallback when Internet Identity cannot be used by the user by making Email + Password login the primary path and not blocking access on Internet Identity availability.
Add an Admin-only frontend UI flow to promote/demote users between "User" and "Admin" roles, so an admin can manage roles without needing developer intervention.

Align profile setup and role display so that user-facing role selection does not mislead users: remove or disable any self-service role selection that does not actually grant admin permissions, and ensure the displayed role reflects the effective authorization role used for gating admin features.
Add backend and frontend safeguards and messaging to explain how a "User" becomes an "Admin" in this system, using English user-facing text.

new_feature_requests.summary: Role-based login system (Admin, Salesman, Supplier) with secure login page and post-login dashboard redirect
Admin dashboard with summary cards (Total Outstanding, Total Collection, Excess Collection, Pending Balance) and Excel report download
Raw data upload module for .xlsx with required columns, auto-display table, search (retailer name/code), and filter by salesman
Payment entry form opened from retailer/invoice row with read-only invoice fields and payment type + multi-mode payment inputs (Cash/Cheque/NEFT-RTGS-UPI)
Part/split payment support with 'Add Another Payment Mode', auto-total calculation, and comparison to balance amount
Excess payment handling with status (Fully Paid/Partially Paid/Excess Payment), warning message, and separate excess storage
Submission workflow to save payment entry, auto-update remaining balance, and show confirmation message
Reports section with filters (date range, salesman, type, mode), retailer-wise ledger, totals (collected/excess/pending), and Excel export
UI/UX design requirements: corporate blue/white theme, ADPL header, clean dashboard cards, mobile responsive, paginated tables, professional layout
Extra features: search by invoice number, payment history per retailer, admin-only edit entry, auto timestamp, and user tracking (who entered data)
Validation rules: no negative amounts; cheque number required if cheque; transaction ID required if online; cannot submit empty form
Footer text: © 2026 ADPL Distribution Management System

Implement backend data models and storage for raw uploaded invoices, payment entries, users/roles, and computed balances, including audit fields (created timestamp and entered-by principal) on every payment entry.
Support CSV upload (or provide clear validation/error messaging when non-.xlsx is uploaded) to prevent runtime errors when viewing invoices
Provide an Admin data-management option to erase/reset previously uploaded invoice/payment data (e.g., clear all data or clear by date range) so daily new invoices/payments can be uploaded fresh
Add an Admin-only backend method that permanently erases previously uploaded invoice data and recorded payments so the system can be used fresh for daily updates.
Add an 'Ageing Days' feature (e.g., column/button) that calculates days from Invoice Date to today to help identify and clear older invoices first

Add an "Ageing Days" column to the downloadable Excel invoice upload template (placed near Invoice Date if possible) while keeping upload parsing compatible by treating the column as optional and ignoring it during import
Make the login page less strict / more usable (relax overly strict login requirements/flow that blocks user access)

Relax backend authorization for basic user bootstrap so newly authenticated principals can read/create their own profile and fetch their effective role without being pre-granted permissions. Ensure these methods only reject anonymous callers, not first-time authenticated users.
Replace Internet Identity authentication with simple Email + Password login, including a 'Create Account' flow and support for multiple Admin/User accounts associated with employee code

Implement a simple email + password authentication system in the Motoko backend that supports account creation and login without requiring Internet Identity, and supports multiple accounts with roles (at minimum: "admin" and "user") tied to an "employee code" field.

Update backend authorization so all existing protected business operations (invoice upload, clear old data, reading invoices, adding/editing payments, reports, payment history) are authorized based on the new email/password session credential and role rules (admin-only where currently admin-only; user-permitted where currently user-permitted), instead of relying on Internet Identity principals.

Implement backend email/password authentication that supports: (1) creating an account, (2) logging in, and (3) returning a session credential that can be reused on future visits so the user does not need to create a new account on each re-login.
Provide a way to change an existing account’s role from User to Admin (e.g., Admin-only promote/demote user roles, or a clear role-update flow)

Add a backend admin-only capability to change another user’s effective authorization role from "user" to "admin" (and optionally back to "user"), so that a user account can be promoted to admin and immediately gain access to admin-only operations (e.g., invoice upload and clear data).
